text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, there's going to be a massive game of "Umamusume tag" using the entire training track. Or at least, that was the plan…

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: Sigh… The rain finally stopped, but I guess it was a mistake to come today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ugh… The course is a total mess. We can't play tag like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, due to the rain, spirits are low for both spectators and participants. There are rumors going around that it might be canceled.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Why?! I've been looking forward to this for forever!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I was gonna show everyone how good I am at getting away… and now I can't!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hold on there, partner! Don't say that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ugh… But there's no way the audience can get pumped up in these conditions…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No, no, you've got it all wrong. You have to remember, El.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We still race even on rainy days, right? The audience gets excited then too, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Then it should be the same for tag, right? It's way too early to give up!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You're absolutely right! It's not like me to ignore a challenge!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A true wrestler is one who fires up the audience no matter what!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's go, Taiki! Time to step into the ring!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's what I'm talkin' about. ♪ Leeet's gooooo!

text_block_list.name: El and Taiki
text_block_list.text: Yaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! The track's a mess, but look at them! They're so fast!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Phew! If I keep running like this, I'm gonna get mud inside my shoes too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: But look at those two go! I'm getting pumped up just watching them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sight of El Condor Pasa and Taiki Shuttle running pulls everyone out of the dumps, and the game of tag ends amidst a storm of hype!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hehe! What's this?! Even the sun came out to see me run!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You were unbelievable, El! I couldn't keep up with ya!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… Like a condor soaring through a storm! I've mastered runnin' in the rain!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ahh, get tagged and you're on the chase, tag someone and you're on the run! That was one heated duel after another!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The audience was really into it too! That's what I call top-notch entertainment!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But the best part was playing with you, Taiki!
